description: Source code for a Python class 'BaseLLMAIOHTTPHandler' that manages HTTP interactions with AI model APIs using aiohttp and httpx, including request handling, response transformation, error handling, and support for image variation endpoints.

classes.name: BaseLLMAIOHTTPHandler
classes.description: A handler class for managing asynchronous and synchronous HTTP requests to AI model APIs, supporting request retries, response processing, error handling, and image variation endpoints.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the handler with optional aiohttp session, transport, and connector, and tracks ownership for cleanup.

methods.name: _get_or_create_transport
methods.description: Retrieves existing transport or creates a new one if needed.

methods.name: _get_connector
methods.description: Retrieves or creates an aiohttp connector from transport or existing attribute.

methods.name: _create_client_session_with_transport
methods.description: Creates an aiohttp ClientSession using transport or connector.

methods.name: _get_async_client_session
methods.description: Returns an existing or newly created aiohttp ClientSession.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the aiohttp client session and transport if owned.

methods.name: _make_common_async_call
methods.description: Performs an async POST request with retries, handling errors and returning the response.

methods.name: _make_common_sync_call
methods.description: Performs a synchronous POST request with retries, handling errors and returning the response.

methods.name: async_completion
methods.description: Handles asynchronous completion requests, transforming responses accordingly.

methods.name: completion
methods.description: Main method to handle completion requests, supporting sync, async, and streaming modes.

methods.name: make_sync_call
methods.description: Performs a synchronous call and returns response iterator and headers.

methods.name: async_image_variations
methods.description: Handles async image variation requests, including form data creation and response transformation.

methods.name: image_variations
methods.description: Main method for image variation requests, supporting both sync and async modes.

methods.name: _handle_error
methods.description: Handles exceptions by raising appropriate API error classes with detailed info.
